description_en: Queries the metadata of a specific edge function (EdgeRoutine), including the EdgeRoutine configuration, configuration version, and code version for each environment
description_zh: 调用DescribeRoutine获取某个边缘函数ER（EdgeRoutine）的元信息，包括每个环境的ER配置、配置版本、代码版本等信息
name: DescribeRoutine

parameters.help_en: The name of the edge function. The name must be unique within the same account
parameters.help_zh: 边缘函数名, 同一个账号下命名唯一
parameters.name: name

Content.description_en: The information about the EdgeRoutine. For more information about the fields, see the following table
Content.description_zh: 包含EdgeRoutine的各项信息。具体字段说明请参见下表
Content.example: CodeRevs, EnvConf, Description, Envs, and CreationTime
